name: journal.window.settings.activity.default.coding.name
instructions: Levels: high=writing or debugging code, medium=reading/reviewing code, low=IDE or editor open but not focused. Detect via: editors, terminals with dev tools, AI coding assistants, git operations. Includes focused code reading and thinking.

name: journal.window.settings.activity.default.browsing.name
instructions: Levels: high=actively navigating/researching, medium=reading a page, low=browser open but idle. Detect via: browser tabs, URL changes, search queries.

name: journal.window.settings.activity.default.email.name
instructions: Levels: high=composing or actively reading email, medium=scanning inbox, low=email client visible but idle. Detect via: email client UI, inbox view, compose window.

name: journal.window.settings.activity.default.messaging.name
instructions: Levels: high=active conversation, medium=reading messages, low=chat app visible but idle. Detect via: chat app UI, message notifications, typing indicators.

name: journal.window.settings.activity.default.ai.conversation.name
instructions: Levels: high=actively prompting and reading responses, medium=reviewing AI output or refining prompts, low=AI chat open but idle. Detect via: AI assistant interfaces (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini), imported AI conversation transcripts, prompt-response patterns. Do not confuse with messaging — AI conversation involves a human interacting with an AI model, not person-to-person chat.

name: journal.window.settings.activity.default.writing.name
instructions: Levels: high=actively composing text, medium=editing/revising, low=document open but not being edited. Detect via: document editors, note apps, text content changing.

name: journal.window.settings.activity.default.reading.name
instructions: Levels: high=focused reading, medium=skimming content, low=document open but attention elsewhere. Detect via: PDF viewers, article pages, documentation sites, reading apps, imported book highlights and annotations. Do not use for reading code — that is coding.

name: journal.window.settings.activity.default.video.name
instructions: Levels: high=actively watching, medium=video playing while doing something else, low=video paused or minimized. Detect via: video player UI, streaming sites, playback controls.

name: journal.window.settings.activity.default.media.name
instructions: Levels: high=media is most of what was heard, medium=media playing while something else happens, low=media faintly in the background. Detect via: a show, film, podcast, broadcast, audiobook or recording heard with no screen showing it.

name: journal.window.settings.activity.default.gaming.name
instructions: Levels: high=actively playing, medium=in menus or waiting, low=game open but tabbed out. Detect via: game window, controller input, game UI elements.

name: journal.window.settings.activity.default.social.name
instructions: Levels: high=posting or actively engaging, medium=scrolling feed, low=social app open but idle. Detect via: social media sites/apps, feed content, post composition.

name: journal.window.settings.activity.default.planning.name
instructions: Levels: high=actively scheduling or preparing agendas, medium=reviewing calendar or event details, low=calendar visible but not being interacted with. Detect via: calendar apps, scheduling interfaces, event creation, imported calendar events, meeting invitations, agenda drafting. Use for scheduling and preparation work. Do not confuse with meeting — planning is the preparation, meeting is the actual synchronous interaction.

name: journal.window.settings.activity.default.productivity.name
instructions: Levels: high=actively editing or organizing, medium=reviewing data, low=app open but not focused. Detect via: spreadsheet/slide editors, project management tools, task boards.

name: journal.window.settings.activity.default.terminal.name
instructions: Levels: high=running commands or scripts, medium=reading output, low=terminal open but idle. Detect via: shell prompts, command output, tmux/screen sessions. If terminal use is clearly coding-related, prefer coding instead.

name: journal.window.settings.activity.default.design.name
instructions: Levels: high=actively creating or editing, medium=reviewing designs, low=design tool open but idle. Detect via: design apps (Figma, Photoshop, etc), canvas editing.

name: journal.window.settings.activity.default.music.name
instructions: Levels: high=actively choosing or browsing music, medium=playlist running while working, low=ambient background audio. Detect via: music player UI, audio playback indicators.
